top_signals.title: Sydney Sweeney Novig ad backlash shows how much women’s sport has changed
top_signals.summary: Top female athletes took control of the conversation around Sydney Sweeney and her ad for Novig, and that is the bit we should pay attention to because it represents real change, writes Matt Readman.
